title: FPGA 資料流加速器
summary: 以HLS、串流管線與有限資源映射連結 16 個技術單元，新增 32 步原理、架構、假想算例、實驗設計與失效驗證。
summaryEn: Sixteen technical units connect hls, streaming pipelines and finite resource mapping through 32 new tasks covering principles, architecture, assumed calculations, experiment design and failure validation.

stages.title: C 模型與硬體契約
stages.description: 四個技術單元以原理／架構與實驗／驗證兩步完成「C 模型與硬體契約」；每步獨立保存進度與知識測驗。
stages.descriptionEn: Four technical units develop c models and hardware contracts through separate principle/architecture and experiment/validation tasks with saved progress and knowledge checks.

steps.title: 功能契約：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「功能契約」建立可檢查的架構、原理與驗證依據。
steps.objectiveEn: Establish reviewable architecture, principles and evidence for functional contract.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「功能契約」的資料、控制與時間關係。C 結果正確不代表硬體時序合格。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「建立輸入、輸出及完成定義。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for functional contract. Correct C output does not establish hardware timing. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Define input, output and completion. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
steps.observation: 建立輸入、輸出及完成定義。
steps.failure: 常見誤判：II 與每筆資料延遲必定相等。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: II always equals per-item latency. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「功能契約」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「C 結果正確不代表硬體時序合格。」。
steps.checkEn: Submit functional contract two-case architecture/state diagrams, parameter table and falsifiable prediction; identify evidence supporting the principle.

knowledge.text: C 結果正確不代表硬體時序合格。

knowledge.title: 功能契約的驗證設計
knowledge.text: 建立輸入、輸出及完成定義。 保留基準與擾動的完整輸入／輸出，以語義、容量或時間條件檢查，並明列假想模型未涵蓋的現實因素。
knowledge.textEn: Define input, output and completion. Retain complete inputs/outputs for baseline and perturbation, check semantic/capacity/timing criteria and state real-world factors omitted from the hypothetical model.

knowledge.title: 本課原創量化算例
knowledge.text: 假設時脈 200 MHz、起始間隔 II=2 cycles，穩態每週期組輸出一筆 4 B，吞吐=100 M筆/s=400 MB/s。延遲 20 cycles=100 ns；短批次另計填充及排空。
knowledge.textEn: Assume 200 MHz, initiation interval II=2 cycles and one 4 B result per initiation. Steady throughput=100 Mitems/s=400 MB/s; 20-cycle latency=100 ns. Short batches also pay fill and drain.

quiz.question: 本步審查「功能契約」與整體「FPGA 資料流加速器」時，哪項陳述或驗證有依據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing functional contract within fpga dataflow accelerators, which statement or check is supported?
options: C 結果正確不代表硬體時序合格。
II 與每筆資料延遲必定相等。
迴圈展開後記憶體埠數不再重要。

II always equals per-item latency.

Check the principle: Correct C output does not establish hardware timing. Preserve input, expected output, observed output and differences. knowledge.text: 把資料傳輸納入總帳。 保留基準與擾動的完整輸入／輸出，以語義、容量或時間條件檢查，並明列假想模型未涵蓋的現實因素。
knowledge.textEn: Include transfers in the total budget. Retain complete inputs/outputs for baseline and perturbation, check semantic/capacity/timing criteria and state real-world factors omitted from the hypothetical model.

knowledge.title: 本課原創量化算例
knowledge.text: 假設時脈 200 MHz、起始間隔 II=2 cycles，穩態每週期組輸出一筆 4 B，吞吐=100 M筆/s=400 MB/s。延遲 20 cycles=100 ns；短批次另計填充及排空。
knowledge.textEn: Assume 200 MHz, initiation interval II=2 cycles and one 4 B result per initiation. Steady throughput=100 Mitems/s=400 MB/s; 20-cycle latency=100 ns. Short batches also pay fill and drain.

scopeEn: Bilingual engineering education from public principles; the workbench is a conceptual simulation, not a complete simulator of any vendor product. Inputs are original teaching assumptions.
